content: Tuuhotwii nnema kwa kihobholelo
Kila mundo jwajhekete kubhehe Yecho ndi Kilichitu akatumitwe na Chapanga kung'ombola, jwenio ndi mwana gwa Chapanga. Na kila mundo jwampala tate ampala na mwana hele.
Yene ndi chitumanye kubhehe tuipala yana ya Chapanga, kwa kumpala Chapanga na kuikamu mihilo jhake.
Nhwalo kumpala Chapanga ndi kujhokanikiya mihilo jhake. Na nhwilo gwake unonopa jhe kuikengama,
nhwalo kila jwabhelwikwe na Chapanga auhotwi nnema. Kwa ndela jhene tuhotwile nnema, kwa kihobholelo chito.
Bho, ghane auhotola nnema? Ndi jhola jwajheketii kubhehe Yecho ndi Mwana gwa Chapanga.
Yecho Kilichitu ndi ghane

Yecho Kilichitu ndi jwakahikite kwa mache na miyahe jha kuwe kwake. Akahikitijhe kwa mache tugha, nambo kwa mache na kwa miyahe jhake. Na Uhuke ndi jwatangacha malobhe ghanga kubhehe Uhuke ndi chakaka.
Bhahe, bhabhii bhatato bhubhitangacha:
Ndi Uhuke gwa Chapanga, mache na miyahe; kwa bhoha bhatato bhajheketelana.
Anda tujheketela chikilongelwa na bhando, bhahe chikilongelwa na Chapanga ndi kitopi hake nhwalo ghanga ndi malobhe ghalongila Chapanga kwa Mwana Mundo.
Jwannyekete Mwana gwa Chapanga abhii uwachakaka kumwojho gwake, nambo jwangannyekete Chapanga, intenda Chapanga kubhehe nhwange, nhwalo akajheketijhe malobhe ghapiita Chapanga kwa Mwana mundo.
Na malobhe gheniya ndi ghanga, Chapanga atupii ughome gwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta, na ghome gwenio ubhii nkate jha Mwana.
Mundo jhojhoha jwabhinako Mwana gwa Chapanga abhii na ghome gweno, jwangabhehe na Mwana gwa Chapanga akwetijhe ghome.
Ghome gwa machiko ghoha
Ninnyandikila mangota ilebhe henge bhumunnyeketile liina lya Mwana gwa Chapanga, umanye kubhehe mmi na ughome gwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta.
Na twenga tubhii nganganga palonge jha Chapanga nhwalo tumanye uchakaka kubhehe pitunnyopa kilebhe chochoha ngita chaipala jwenio atujhokanikiya.
Jwenio atujhokonikiya kila pitunnyopa na nhwalo tumanye kubhehe jweno atujhokonikiya kila pitunnyopa, tumanye hele kubhehe atupe ghoha ghitunnyopa.

Mundo anda amwehi nnongo mundo atenda uhakaho lyangannete kuwegha, ipalwa kunyopee kwa Chapanga na Chapanga nampela ughome. Nilonge yenio kwa bhala bhubhatehi uhakaho gwangapaleke kuwe. Nambo ubhii uhakaho ghumpelekela mundo mu kuwegha, nanenga nilonge jhe kubhehe mipalwa kunnyopa Chapanga nhwalo gwa gheniya.
Kila kitendwa changanandela palonge jha Chapanga ndi uhakaho, nambo ubhii uhakaho gwangampeleke mundo mu kuwegha.
Tumanye kubhehe kila jwabhelwikwe na Chapanga ahenga jhe uhakaho, nhwalo jwenio ulondwa na Mwana jwa Chapanga, yenio Limbembela intendajhe kilebhe.
Tumanye twenga ndi yana ya Chapanga pamo nakubhehe nnema ghoha ulongochwa na Limbembela jwenio.

Chakaka tumanye kubhehe Mwana gwa Chapanga ahikite, atupehile malango tumanye Chapanga jwa uchakaka, tutama kwa kulombana na Chapanga jwa uchakaka na kulombana na Mwana mundo, Yecho Kilichitu. Na jhonjo ndi Chapanga jwa uchakaka na ghongo ndi ghome gwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta.
Yana yango mwibhambale kuijhinamii ichapanga yawange!
